arguments.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production RGBA battle animation source, NOT a promotional illustration. Input 1 is the canonical face, fitted armor, adult body proportions and material rendering. Input 2 is the accepted standing-body scale and costume reference only. Create FOUR genuinely different consecutive full-body drawings in a strict equal 2x2 grid, 1536x1536 square, transparent background. Natural 8-head adult proportions, small mature narrow grey-green eyes, stern long almond eye shape, defined straight nose and jaw, cool intimidating expression matching Input 1 exactly. No cute face, no round childlike eyes, no enlarged head, no smile. Face, hands, armor and cape share the same refined 2D animation/painterly rendering. Preserve silver flowing hair, every white-silver armor plate and gold thorn trim, black joint undersuit, slim long legs, long ivory cape with black lining and gold embroidery. Hair is flowing fine natural strands not plastic spikes. Each figure occupies ONLY 62% OF ITS QUADRANT HEIGHT with broad fully empty margins. The subject must not fill the cell. Keep head-to-sole height equal across figures before accounting for crouch. Fit the entire cape and each complete fingertip and toe well inside each cell. Keep trailing cape gathered in compact folds behind body rather than spreading 2 body-heights sideways. Four distinct isolated characters surrounded by abundant empty space. The native-sized asset packer will restore exact 610-pixel anatomy; this source-sheet margin is only technical packaging. Each holds ONLY the exact short black/gold grip stub in his right armored hand: NO GUARD, NO BLADE, NO EXTRA WEAPONS. The approved blade/guard will be rigid-composited later. Five anatomically correct fingers gripping naturally, connected wrists, no extra fingers. Same camera: full-body 3/4 facing RIGHT, eye-level battle sprite, minimal perspective, no zoom or foreshortening changes. Redraw the ENTIRE connected head/neck/body for every pose, do not paste faces. No ground disc, labels, text, particles, aura, shadows on background, or frame borders. Sequence B, frames5-8 after a powerful rightward horizontal sword cut. Top-left: cutting arm follows through slightly below chest, stern head faces right, compact right-hand stub angled 25 degrees down-right, torso rotates through, left arm bent behind, lead knee planted, cape swung to left. Top-right: momentum settles into low finishing guard, right hand drops to right hip, stub angled 55 degrees down-right, balanced grounded stance, cloak arcs then falls. Bottom-left: recovers tall posture, foot draws back slightly, right elbow folds, stub angled 80 degrees down-right, calm deadly gaze right. Bottom-right: returns to same tall and imposing low-guard stance as original art, slim torso, feet shoulder width, right hand low near screen-left hip holding grip angled145 degrees down-left, cape rests, stern composed face. No running, no fencing point, no extreme crouch, no tiny childlike body. Full connected head/neck/body in every pose.
